meta.name: add-mnemon
meta.description: Add persistent graph-based memory via mnemon. Agents recall past context before responding and remember insights after each turn.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体记住每次对话，自动回忆历史并沉淀洞察
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在开发智能体，需要让它记住多轮对话的关键信息
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building AI agents that need to remember context across conversations.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会在每次回复前自动翻出与该话题相关的旧对话内容,并在每轮对话结束后把值得记下的见解存入持久记忆;这些记忆存放在每个智能体组自己的目录里,容器重启也不会丢。
howto.when: 每次对话中,在 Claude 开口回答前会先调取相关记忆作出回应,一轮结束又会把这段对话的要点保存下来;仅在使用默认 Claude 配置(provider 为 claude 或未设置)时才生效。

say.text: 你还记得我之前说过的配色方案吗?
say.note: Claude 会从记忆里调出相关旧内容。

say.text: 记住,这个项目的截止日期是下周五。
say.note: 本轮结束后这条事实会被存入记忆。

say.text: 接着上次聊到一半的 API 设计继续。
say.note: 新会话也能回忆起上次的进度。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude recalls relevant past context before each reply and stores new insights after every turn. Memory lives in the per-agent-group .claude directory and survives container restarts.
howto.when_en: Triggers on the default Claude provider (provider absent or claude): recall right before each response, storage after each turn. Not active under other providers such as opencode.

say_en.text: Do you remember the color scheme I mentioned before?
say_en.note: Claude pulls up relevant old context from memory.

say_en.text: Remember, the project deadline is next Friday.
say_en.note: This fact is stored in memory after the turn.

say_en.text: Let's continue the API design from our last conversation.
say_en.note: A new session can recall the earlier progress.
